input.question: How come the F-35 program cost way more to develop than the F-22 despite being generally less technologically advanced?
input.ground_truth: F-35 is pretty much 3 different planes, that look similar. * Navy version has different wings and modifications to frame to support carrier landing. * Marine version has VSTOL. * Air Force version has better performance.

Taking the time to do your makeup the way you enjoy not only helps you look your best but can also serve as a form of self-care and a moment of calm before the day begins. Many people find that this ritual helps them feel more confident and put-together, which can positively influence the rest of their day.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: How come the F-35 program cost way more to develop than the F-22 despite being generally less technologically advanced?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you and your friend both want to build a really cool toy car. You want yours to do lots of different things—fly really far, hide from other toy cars, and change its shape a little bit. Your friend just wants a super fast car that looks cool.

Now, your toy car has to do *so* many things and can change in many ways. That means you have to try lots and lots of ideas to make sure it works just right. You might have to buy special parts and fix things over and over. Because you want it to be perfect for so many jobs, it costs a LOT of money and takes a long, long time.

Your friend’s car is also fancy, but it doesn’t have to do as many things. But even so, making new things is always expensive and takes a long time.

But here’s the funny part: even though your toy car (like the F-35) was supposed to be a little simpler than your friend’s old super fancy car (the F-22), you ended up spending even MORE money on yours! That’s because your toy car had to work for so many different people and countries, and you kept changing your mind about what it should do. Plus, you wanted to make sure it didn’t break and could be fixed easily everywhere in the world. So, all those changes and extra safety stuff made it cost even more than your friend’s car, even though it wasn’t supposed to be as complicated!

That’s kind of what happened with the F-35 and F-22 airplanes.
